messages:
maya: quick signal — noticed a small wave of SSO failures after the Nostromo IdP pushed a metadata update at 03:02 UTC. Affected users see auth succeed but get booted immediately.

rachel: saw that too. SP logs show assertion verified but server-side decrypt of session blob times out (rpc deadline). cookie created then cleared.

tom: infra did a KMS envelope roll at 03:01:30 UTC; metrics show a p95 jump ~2.8s for ~90s. likely overlap.

maya: are we acking SCIM changes when decrypt fails? auditors will hate silent drops.

rachel: current behavior: we ack to avoid idp retry storms. but that also hides failures. suggest changing to return 409 on decrypt timeout so IdP can retry once.

tom: short term I'll add a cached-decrypt fallback (TTL 12h) and emit metric idp_kms_decrypt_timeouts. long term we need a platform pattern for KMS error handling.

oncall-bot: incident created INC-2026-042-01: "Nostromo IdP metadata update overlapped KMS rekey causing decrypt timeouts -> session invalidation & silent SCIM drops".

maya: good call. I'll draft postmortem and compliance note to ensure preflight audit entries are recorded before applying RBAC writes.

rachel: will add test that simulates KMS latency during rotations. tagging infra to stagger future rekeys. :thumbsup:
